seoTitle: Fifth Sorrowful Mystery: The Crucifixion | Rosary Book
seoDescription: A read-aloud decade book for children on the Fifth Sorrowful Mystery, the Crucifixion: the story, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a reflection.
intro: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Crucifixion.
shortAnswer: This book walks children through the Fifth Sorrowful Mystery, the Crucifixion: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on self-giving love and repentance.
aboutHtml:
Painting: Diego Velázquez, Christ Crucified (Prado). Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Image source (Wikimedia Commons).

The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Tuesday / Friday.

faq.q: What is the Fifth Sorrowful Mystery?
faq.a: The Crucifixion. On Calvary, Jesus was nailed to the cross between two thieves. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Tuesday / Friday, and its fruit is self-giving love and repentance.

faq.q: How do you pray this decade with children?
faq.a: Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.

productionNote: Read aloud in the browser with your device voice; studio narration is not available yet. The painting is a public-domain work credited below.
